# Tiny Chip Studio

> Website design and business growth in Tiffin, Ohio. Attract attention, make contact easier, and understand what follows. Your website. Your business. Your call.

Websites from $197/month. Website + Growth $297/month. $0 upfront builds for qualifying projects with a 12-month initial agreement. Build & Own from $1,200 with no required care plan.

## Services

- Website + Growth: $297/month. 12-MONTH INITIAL AGREEMENT. Your website and ongoing care, plus a system for keeping inquiries organized, following up and seeing which opportunities turn into business. $0 upfront build fee for qualifying projects with a 12-month initial agreement. $3,564 total first-year payments. We set up your inquiry and follow-up system around your business. We agree on the features, usage limits and launch timeline before work begins, then configure and test your workflows during onboarding.
- Website + Care: $197/month. 12-MONTH INITIAL AGREEMENT. Get a website you’re proud to share, with someone handling the hosting, upkeep and small updates. $0 upfront build fee for qualifying projects. $2,364 total first-year payments.
- Build & Own: From $1,200. ONE TIME · NO REQUIRED CARE PLAN. A distinctive website purchased outright. Agreed custom deliverables transfer after full payment, subject to third-party licenses. Choose your hosting and future provider. No mandatory care subscription. Hosting and domain costs are separate; growth services can be scoped separately when appropriate.
- Website Care: From $99/month. FOR QUALIFYING EXISTING SITES. Technical care and minor updates after a review of your site, platform and access. WordPress hosting is outside our current active scope. No new website build, full CRM setup, advanced automation, campaign management or complete Growth reporting package. Scope and costs are agreed separately.

We agree on the project scope, support, ownership and any third-party costs in writing before work starts. Monthly plans also spell out early-exit arrangements, offboarding and your options after the initial year. Domains and third-party subscriptions may cost extra.

## How a project works

1. Clarify: understand the business, its customers and the next action a visitor should take.
2. Create: shape the message, the design and the working website.
3. Deliver: test, refine and hand off a dependable result.

A typical website takes about a week of build time once content and approvals are in.
